title: ESR and U-series analyses of faunal material from Cuddie Springs, NSW, Australia: implications for the timing of the extinction of the Australian megafauna
version: Quaternary Science Reviews 29, 596–610, DOI 10.1016/j.quascirev.2009.11.004, ANU repository publisher PDF
lineage: Separate laboratory study on faunal samples from the same site, not another determination on the stone tool. Inspected PDF SHA-256 910f68d1191707e36d179d788c355998f516f04619dacbe88f47becf86e0ec6f.
